label: Late-episode GO feature, suppressed after unrewarded S2 outcomes, boosted when S1 seems good.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * ((prev_state - prev_reward == 2) + (tv("state", -2) - tv("reward", -2) == 2)) * ep_trial ;; (phase == GO) * (belief_lo > 0) * ep_trial ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * ep_trial
terms: (phase == GO) * (prev_state - prev_reward == 2) * ep_trial ;; (phase == GO) * (tv("state", -2) - tv("reward", -2) == 2) * ep_trial ;; (phase == GO) * (tv("state", -3) - tv("reward", -3) == 2) * ep_trial ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * ep_trial ;; (phase == GO) * (belief > 0.5) * ep_trial ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) * ep_trial ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == 1) * ep_trial ;; (phase == GO) * (tv("state", -2) - tv("reward", -2) == 0) * ep_trial
explanation: Fires only at GO and only late in the episode (timing baseline grows from trial ~40 to ~100). Its graded size grows with episode trial and is gated by recent outcomes: each of the last two trials that ended in S2 unrewarded cuts it sharply (to ~0 in examples), the observer believing S1 is good raises it, and a previous a2->S1 rare rewarded trial boosts it most. S1 outcomes or rewarded trials keep it at about 2. All terms are scaled by ep_trial because the effect is multiplicative with the late-episode ramp. Short form dev R^2 beyond timing 0.29 vs free fit 0.33 (about 90%); the free fit adds a third-back S2-unrewarded trial and main effects of prev reward/state. The residual is mostly an on/off pattern within late GO steps that a linear ramp does not capture. Uses no future, hidden or model-output variables.
